component.name: Wallora 2
component.summary: Wallpaper manager with animated video support

description.p: Wallora 2 is a GTK4/libadwaita wallpaper manager for Linux. It handles static images (color correction, scaling, slideshow) and animated wallpapers (MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV, AVI, GIF).
Wallora 2 to menedżer tapet GTK4/libadwaita dla Linuksa. Obsługuje statyczne obrazy (korekcja, skalowanie, slideshow) oraz animowane tapety (MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV, AVI, GIF).

ul.li: Animated wallpapers on GNOME, Hyprland/Sway and X11
Favorites vault outside the system disk
Animowane tapety na GNOME, Hyprland/Sway i X11

description.p: Fix restore after logout so the wallpaper starts in the new session instead of a leftover process.
Naprawa przywracania tapety po wylogowaniu — nowa sesja zamiast procesu-zombie.
